contentEn:
Vancouver's climate demands reliable heating in winter and growing demand for cooling in summers that now regularly hit 30 C. A heat pump HVAC system handles both from a single unit and in 2026 government rebates make the upgrade more affordable than ever. Here is what the system costs, what the renovation around it involves, and what Reno Stars charges for the surrounding construction work.

Heat pump HVAC system cost in Vancouver 2026
A new heat pump HVAC system in Vancouver costs $12,000-$22,000 before rebates. After federal Canada Greener Homes Grant and BC Heat Pump rebates, the net cost typically lands between $8,000 and $18,000 depending on home size. This is a genuinely all-in figure for the equipment, installation, and standard permits.

System Type | Home Size | Gross Cost | After Rebates (est.)
Mini-split (1-2 zones) | Condo / townhouse | $8,000-$12,000 | $4,000-$7,000
Multi-split (3-4 zones) | Single-family home | $12,000-$18,000 | $6,000-$11,000
Ducted central system | Large single-family home | $18,000-$28,000 | $10,000-$18,000

Reno Stars does not sell the heat pump unit itself - that is handled by a licensed HVAC contractor. Reno Stars handles everything around it: the wall opening for the outdoor unit, electrical conduit routing, condensate drain plumbing, and any interior finishes that need to be opened up and repaired.

What renovation work does a heat pump installation require?
Most heat pump installations require some level of renovation work even when framed as a simple swap. The outdoor unit needs a level, code-compliant pad or wall bracket. Electrical service may need upgrading - especially in pre-1990 homes where 60-amp panels are common. Condensate drainage must connect to the building drain without violating plumbing codes. Interior walls opened for refrigerant lines need plaster or drywall repair and repainting.

Reno Stars has completed these renovations alongside heat pump installations in Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, and North Vancouver. The work typically runs $2,500-$6,000 depending on how much opening-up is required.

Outdoor unit pad or wall bracket installation
Electrical conduit routing from panel to outdoor unit location
Condensate drain plumbing to floor drain or external drainage
Interior wall chases for refrigerant lines (drywall open and repair)
Panel board upgrades where existing electrical service is insufficient
Permit coordination for electrical and plumbing work

What rebates are available for heat pump installation in BC in 2026?
British Columbia and the federal government have stacked incentive programs that substantially offset heat pump costs. The primary programs active in 2026 are:

Canada Greener Homes Grant: up to $5,000 for heat pump installation, stackable with provincial programs.
BC Heat Pump Rebate: up to $10,000 depending on household income and whether you are replacing electric baseboard heating, oil, or gas.
Clean BC Better Homes: additional top-up rebates of $1,000-$3,000 for income-qualified households.

To access rebates your heat pump must be installed by a licensed contractor and your home must have an EnerGuide assessment before and after the installation. Reno Stars works alongside your HVAC contractor to ensure all renovation work meets the documentation requirements for rebate claims.

How long does heat pump HVAC installation take?
The heat pump installation itself typically takes one to two days once the unit and contractor are confirmed. The surrounding Reno Stars renovation work - electrical routing, condensate plumbing, wall repairs - adds three to five days depending on the scope. Total project duration from first site visit to finished work is typically 10-20 business days.

A renovation around a heat pump installation in a strata property requires strata council approval for the exterior unit placement. That process adds two to six weeks in most Metro Vancouver stratas. Reno Stars has managed this process in Richmond, Burnaby, and West Vancouver stratas.

Do I need a permit for heat pump installation in Vancouver?
Electrical permits are required for any new dedicated circuit for the heat pump. If your electrical panel needs an upgrade, that requires a separate electrical permit. Condensate drain connections to the building drain may require a plumbing permit in the City of Vancouver. The good news is that heat pump installations themselves are exempt from building permits in most Metro Vancouver municipalities when replacing an existing heating system - but the associated electrical and plumbing work is not.

Reno Stars coordinates all permit applications as part of the renovation contract.

How does a heat pump compare to gas furnace heating in Vancouver?
Vancouver has some of the lowest electricity rates in North America, making heat pumps especially economical for heating. Running a heat pump in heating mode costs roughly 30-50% less than electric baseboard heating and is competitive with natural gas at current Vancouver gas rates of approximately $4.50/GJ. There is no combustion on-site, no carbon monoxide risk, and no gas line connection needed.

Heat pumps also provide active cooling - something a gas furnace alone cannot do. Given that Vancouver summers are increasingly hot, this is a significant practical advantage. A single system handles both heating and cooling rather than maintaining separate systems.

What does Reno Stars charge for heat pump renovation work?
Reno Stars quotes heat pump adjacent renovation work on a fixed-price basis after an on-site assessment. Typical all-in costs for common scenarios:

Scenario | Scope | Reno Stars Cost Range
Condo mini-split | Condensate drain, small wall patch, one trade coordination | $1,500-$3,000
Single-family, panel upgrade included | Full electrical routing, condensate, drywall, panel upgrade coordination | $4,000-$7,500
Strata townhouse | Strata approval, exterior pad, interior routing | $3,000-$5,500
Large home, multi-zone ducted | Central routing, multiple wall chases, extended timeline | $7,000-$12,000

All prices exclude HST, heat pump equipment, and licensed HVAC contractor fees. Prices are in Canadian dollars.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can Reno Stars install the heat pump unit itself?
No. Heat pump equipment and the mechanical installation must be performed by a licensed HVAC contractor with the appropriate BC contractor licence. Reno Stars handles all the construction, electrical, and plumbing work surrounding the heat pump unit, and can recommend vetted HVAC partners if you do not already have one.

Does heat pump installation require a building permit in Vancouver?
Building permits are generally not required for the heat pump swap itself. However, electrical permits for new dedicated circuits are always required, and plumbing permits may apply for condensate drain connections in the City of Vancouver. Strata approval is required for any exterior unit placement in most Metro Vancouver stratas.

How much can I save on heating bills with a heat pump in Vancouver?
On Vancouver's low electricity rates, a heat pump typically reduces annual heating costs by 30-50% compared to electric baseboard heating, and is cost-competitive with natural gas. Actual savings depend on your home's insulation, the heat pump model chosen, and your usage patterns.

How long does a heat pump last in Vancouver's climate?
A properly installed heat pump in Vancouver has a typical service life of 15-20 years. Regular maintenance - annual filter changes and periodic professional servicing - extends that lifespan. The equipment warranty is typically 10-12 years from the manufacturer.

What is the BC heat pump rebate income threshold?
BC's Heat Pump Rebate has an upper income threshold of approximately $100,000 household income for the full rebate, scaling down to a minimum rebate for households earning over $130,000. The federal Greener Homes Grant has no income threshold. Reno Stars can help you understand which programs you are likely to qualify for during a free consultation.

contentZh:
温哥华的气候要求冬季可靠供暖，夏季制冷需求也不断增加——如今气温经常达到30C。热泵暖通空调系统用一个设备同时解决冷暖问题，而且2026年政府补贴使升级比以往更实惠。以下是系统费用、相关改造工程内容，以及 Reno Stars 对周边工程的收费。

2026年温哥华热泵暖通空调系统多少钱?
温哥华的新热泵暖通空调系统价格在 $12,000-$22,000 之间，补贴前。在联邦绿色家园补助金和卑诗省热泵补贴之后，净成本通常在 $8,000 到 $18,000 之间，具体取决于房屋面积。这是设备、安装和标准许可的全包价格。

系统类型 | 房屋面积 | 补贴前价格 | 补贴后（估算）
分体式（1-2区） | 公寓 / 联排别墅 | $8,000-$12,000 | $4,000-$7,000
多联式（3-4区） | 独立屋 | $12,000-$18,000 | $6,000-$11,000
管道中央系统 | 大型独立屋 | $18,000-$28,000 | $10,000-$18,000

Reno Stars 不销售热泵设备本身——这由持牌暖通空调承包商负责。Reno Stars 负责围绕热泵的一切工程：室外机的墙孔安装、电缆管道路由、冷凝水排水管道，以及需要打开和修复的室内饰面。

热泵安装需要哪些改造工程?
大多数热泵安装即使被描述为简单更换，也需要一定程度的改造工程。室外机需要一个水平、符合规范的底座或壁挂支架。电路可能需要升级——尤其是1990年以前建造的房屋，通常配备60安培电箱。冷凝水排放必须连接到建筑排水管，且不得违反水管规范。打开墙壁铺设制冷剂管线后，需要修补石膏板或干墙并重新粉刷。

Reno Stars 已在温哥华、列治文、本拿比和北温完成热泵安装配套改造工程。相关工程费用通常在 $2,500-$6,000 之间，取决于需要打开的范围。

室外机底座或壁挂支架安装
从配电箱到室外机位置的电线管道敷设
冷凝水排水管道连接到地漏或外部排水
制冷剂管线的内墙开槽（石膏板开合修复）
现有电路不足以支持时更换配电箱
电气和水管工程的许可协调

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars: /en/contact/

2026年BC省热泵安装有哪些补贴?
卑诗省和联邦政府推出了叠加激励计划，大幅抵消热泵成本。2026年有效的主要项目包括：

联邦绿色家园补助金：热泵安装最高补贴 $5,000，可与省级项目叠加。
BC热泵补贴：最高 $10,000，取决于家庭收入以及您是用电踢脚板取暖、燃油还是燃气取暖。
Clean BC Better Homes：符合收入条件的家庭可获得额外 $1,000-$3,000 的补贴。

要获得补贴，热泵必须由持牌承包商安装，并且房屋必须在安装前后进行 EnerGuide 评估。Reno Stars 与您的暖通空调承包商合作，确保所有改造工程符合补贴申请的文件要求。

热泵暖通空调安装需要多长时间?
热泵安装本身通常在确认设备和承包商后一至两天完成。Reno Stars 的周边改造工程（电线管道、冷凝水管道、墙壁修复）则需要额外三至五天。整个项目从首次现场勘查到工程完成，通常需要 10-20 个工作日。

在共管物业中安装热泵的改造工程，需要获得共管委员会的批准才能放置室外机。这个流程在大多数大温哥华共管物业中需要额外两到六周时间。Reno Stars 已在列治文、本拿比和西温的共管物业中完成此流程。

温哥华热泵安装需要许可证吗?
热泵的任何新的专用电路都需要电气许可。如果您的配电箱需要升级，则需要单独的电气许可。冷凝水排放连接到建筑排水管时，在温哥华市可能需要水管许可。好消息是，在大多数大温哥华城市，热泵安装本身在更换现有供暖系统时通常免于建筑许可——但相关的电气和水管工程不在此列。

Reno Stars 作为改造合同的一部分，协调所有许可申请。

热泵与燃气锅炉在温哥华的比较如何?
温哥华拥有北美最低的电价之一，使热泵制热特别经济。与电踢脚板取暖相比，热泵制热模式运行成本降低约 30-50%，与目前温哥华约 $4.50/GJ 的天然气价格相比也具有竞争力。现场无燃烧、无一氧化碳风险，也无需燃气管道连接。

热泵还提供主动制冷——燃气锅炉本身无法做到这一点。鉴于温哥华的夏天越来越热，这是一个重要的实际优势。一个系统同时解决冷暖问题，无需维护两套系统。

Reno Stars 对热泵改造工程的收费是多少?
Reno Stars 在现场评估后按固定价格提供热泵配套改造工程的报价。常见场景的全包费用：

场景 | 工程范围 | Reno Stars 费用区间
公寓分体式 | 冷凝水排水、小面积墙面修补、一个专业协调 | $1,500-$3,000
独立屋含配电箱升级 | 全电线管道、冷凝水、石膏板、配电箱升级协调 | $4,000-$7,500
共管联排别墅 | 共管委员会批准、室外底座、室内管道 | $3,000-$5,500
大型多区管道住宅 | 中央管道、多处墙面开槽、延长时间线 | $7,000-$12,000

所有价格不含HST、热泵设备和持牌暖通空调承包商费用。以加元计价。

常见问题

Reno Stars 能安装热泵设备本身吗?
不能。热泵设备和机械安装必须由持有BC省承包商执照的暖通空调承包商执行。Reno Stars 负责热泵设备周围的所有建筑、电气和水管工程，如果您还没有暖通空调合作伙伴，我们可以推荐经过审核的合作方。

温哥华热泵安装需要建筑许可证吗?
热泵更换本身通常不需要建筑许可证。但新的专用电路总是需要电气许可证，在温哥华市，冷凝水排放连接到建筑排水管可能需要水管许可证。在大多数大温哥华共管物业中，任何室外机放置都需要共管委员会批准。

在温哥华使用热泵每年能节省多少取暖费用?
在温哥华的低电价下，热泵通常比电踢脚板取暖减少 30-50% 的年度取暖费用，与天然气取暖成本相当。实际节省取决于您房屋的隔热性能、所选热泵型号以及使用习惯。

热泵在温哥华气候下的使用寿命是多久?
在温哥华，正确安装的热泵使用寿命通常为 15-20 年。定期维护——每年更换过滤网和定期专业保养——可延长使用寿命。设备保修期通常为制造商提供 10-12 年。

BC省热泵补贴的收入门槛是多少?
BC省热泵补贴的全额补贴收入上限约为家庭收入 $100,000，收入超过 $130,000 则获得最低补贴。联邦绿色家园补助金没有收入门槛要求。在免费咨询期间，Reno Stars 可以帮助您了解您可能符合哪些项目的资格。
